ESO states that the proprietary period protects raw and derived data until release and distributes archive data under CC BY 4.0 with acknowledgment requirements. No product bytes are downloaded.

The anonymous public NED TAP service documents programmatic cone searches of the NED Object Directory and requests NED acknowledgment. CTAS retains bounded source-native rows and provenance only. NOIRLab's provider-owned API authentication notebook states that anyone may retrieve public files while proprietary-file retrieval requires authorization.
